personality_one_liner: A calm, highly readable, and deeply professional utility interface designed to reduce cognitive load during and after stressful psychosocial emergency missions.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for forms to avoid tapping errors. Strict safe-area compliance. Cards should never be flush to the screen edge.

do's: Use glassmorphism for the bottom tab bar
Use glass for sticky header backgrounds over scrollable lists/forms
Use frosted glass overlay for the sticky 'Als PDF exportieren' CTA container at the bottom of the details screen
dont's: Do not use glass on form inputs or list items
Do not use on cards in dense lists

screens.name: Einsätze (Home)
screens.purpose: A quick-scan list of all documented missions.

states.empty: Illustration of a notebook with 'Keine Einsätze dokumentiert. Tippe auf den Tab Neuer Einsatz, um zu beginnen.'

screens.layout: Top sticky header with title 'Einsätze'. Below, a single column of cards. Each card displays the date/time, Einsatzort (location), Stichwort (keyword), and a status chip. Use MD spacing between cards. Do not cramp rows.

screens.name: Neuer Einsatz
screens.purpose: A highly structured, stress-free form for documenting PSNV-B care.

states.empty: N/A - this is a data entry form.

screens.layout: Single-column, vertically stacked form. Wrap in KeyboardAvoidingView. Labels sit above inputs. Group fields into clear sections (Einsatzdaten, Betroffene, Zustand & Symptome, Maßnahmen, Übergabe) using subtle dividers and XL top margins. Sticky 'Speichern' button anchored at the bottom with safe-area clearance.

screens.name: Einsatz Details
screens.purpose: Read-only overview of a documented mission with a clear action to export.
screens.layout: Hero section at top with date and large title (Stichwort). Below, read-only grouped rows matching the form sections, but presented as text pairs (Label / Value). A sticky glass container at the bottom holds the 'Als PDF exportieren' primary button.

screens.name: Statistik
screens.purpose: Overview of mission volume and types.

states.empty: Illustration with 'Noch keine Daten für Statistiken.'

screens.layout: Top hero banner using the statistics chart abstract image with a vertical gradient scrim. Below, large metric cards for 'Total Missions' and 'Missions this Month', followed by a list of event types (Stichworte) with their counts.

screens.name: Einstellungen
screens.purpose: Configure default responder information to save time during documentation.
screens.layout: Simple list layout. Fields for 'Name der Einsatzkraft' and 'Organisation'. A top cover banner using the calm sage gradient image.

empty_state_notebook.alt: Top down view of a calm desk with notebook and pen

statistics_cover.alt: Abstract blue and white chart interface

settings_cover.alt: Soothing abstract gradient of sage green tones

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided; absolutely NO blue, navy, or purple shades are allowed. Rely on the calming sage green brand color.
Form inputs must always have labels placed ABOVE the input field. Do not use floating labels.
All form entry must happen in a single vertical scrollable column (Neuer Einsatz). Ensure a sticky 'Speichern' button at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView.
Include standard PSNV-B specific fields in the form: Datum, Ort, Stichwort, Betroffene (Name/Alter/Rolle), Symptome, Maßnahmen, and Übergabe.
Implement AsyncStorage strictly for all local data saving, as requested.
Use expo-print and expo-sharing to implement the PDF export functionality for the mission details.
Font weights must never exceed 500 (use size and color for hierarchy, not weight).
Images used as banners (Statistik and Einstellungen) must have a top-down vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.
Do not use emojis anywhere in the UI.
